raw.details:
Welcome to Data Sprint 2.0 – by Anveshan!

Data Sprint 2.0: A Global AI & ML Problem-Solving Challenge!

About the Opportunity

  • Data Sprint 2.0 is a 36-hour online AI & ML hackathon organized by Anveshan, the Applied Research & AI/ML Club of The National Institute of Engineering, Mysuru, taking place from 23rd to 25th November 2026.

  • The hackathon brings together college students and working professionals to tackle real-world challenges through innovation, machine learning, technical skills, teamwork, and creative problem-solving.

  • With 4 exciting AI & ML tracks, participants will develop practical AI/ML solutions and showcase their technical expertise. All four tracks have now been officially announced! Participants can explore the tracks through Anveshan's official social media platforms and start preparing for the competition.

  • Detailed problem statements will be released 36 hours before the evaluation.

  • An assistance round will be conducted following the release of problem statements, where Anveshan volunteers will help participants clarify doubts and understand the challenges.

  • Shortlisted teams will advance to the final evaluation round, where they will present their solutions and compete for exciting rewards.

The 4 Tracks Are Now LIVE!

The wait is over! All four tracks for Data Sprint 2.0 have officially been revealed!

Head over to Anveshan's official social media platforms to explore the announced tracks, discover the challenge domains, and start brainstorming with your team.

Explore the Tracks & Follow Anveshan:

  • Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/anveshan_nie

  • LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/anveshan-nie/

  • X (Twitter): https://x.com/anveshannie

Explore the tracks, choose your challenge, and gear up for 36 hours of innovation!

Stay connected through our official channels for problem statements, competition schedules, important instructions, and further announcements.

Our Official Gold Partners

InterviewBuddy – Technology & Rewards Partner

We are excited to welcome InterviewBuddy as an Official Gold Partner for Data Sprint 2.0!

InterviewBuddy is an interview preparation platform offering AI-powered mock interviews and expert-driven interview sessions, helping students and professionals strengthen their interview skills and prepare for career opportunities.

Exclusive InterviewBuddy Benefits:

  • Winners: AI Mock Interview Vouchers worth ₹550 each.

  • Runners-up: Exclusive 90% discount vouchers for AI Mock Interviews.

  • All Registered Participants: 10% discount on InterviewBuddy's expert-driven interview sessions.

This collaboration brings valuable career development opportunities to Data Sprint 2.0 participants.

Explore InterviewBuddy: https://interviewbuddy.net

Navan AI – Community & Agentic AI Partner

We are delighted to welcome Navan AI, a Singapore-based AI technology company, as an Official Gold Partner for Data Sprint 2.0!

Navan AI focuses on AI automation, agentic workflows, and multi-agent development, empowering developers and innovators with practical tools, learning resources, and collaborative communities.

Through this partnership, participants gain access to AI automation resources, developer communities, and opportunities to interact with industry professionals.

Exclusive Navan AI Benefits:

  • Free Premium Community Access: All registered participants receive 100% discounted access to Navan AI's paid Skool community, normally valued at US$19/month, featuring AI automation and spec coding courses, alongside networking opportunities.

  • Agentic AI Tools & Frameworks: Access to Navan AI's open-source workflows and agents through soda.navan.ai, alongside the SAM Multi-Agent Development Framework, designed for use with Gemini, Antigravity, Claude, Copilot, and similar tools.

  • Industry Mentorship: An opportunity to learn from a Navan AI team member participating as a mentor or judge during the event, subject to availability.

Community invitations and technology access instructions will be communicated through official event channels.

Explore Navan AI: https://asca.navan.ai

Explore Agentic AI Tools: https://soda.navan.ai

SAM Framework: https://github.com/sam-agents/sam

Rewards and Benefits

  • ₹30,000 worth of merchandise rewards for outstanding performances.

  • InterviewBuddy Rewards: AI Mock Interview Vouchers worth ₹550 each for winners, 90% discount vouchers for runners-up, and 10% discounts on expert-driven interview sessions for all registered participants.

  • Navan AI Premium Community: Complimentary access to a paid AI automation and spec coding learning community, normally valued at US$19/month, for all registered participants.

  • Agentic AI Technology Access: Explore Navan AI's open-source workflows, agents, and SAM Multi-Agent Development Framework.

  • Industry Mentorship: Potential mentorship or judging interaction with a Navan AI team member, subject to availability.

  • Expert Consultations: 10 lucky participants will receive a complimentary 30-minute consultation with industry professionals or researchers.

  • Global Exposure: Collaborate, compete, and connect with a diverse international community of AI/ML enthusiasts and innovators.

Eligibility

  • Open to college students and working professionals.

  • Participants from all branches and specializations are welcome.

  • Inter-college teams are allowed.

  • Inter-specialization teams are allowed.

  • Each participant can be part of only one team.

Competition Format

  • Mode: Online

  • Dates: 23rd–25th November 2026

  • Duration: 36 Hours

  • Tracks: 4 AI & ML problem-solving tracks

  • Track Details: Officially announced and available on Anveshan's Instagram, LinkedIn, and X accounts.

  • Problem Statements: Released 36 hours before evaluation

  • Assistance Round: Guidance and doubt clarification by Anveshan researchers

  • Final Round: Shortlisted teams present their solutions for evaluation

Rules

  • Each participant can register as a member of only one team.

  • All submissions must be original. Plagiarism or copying solutions from other teams is strictly prohibited.

  • Teams must work on the officially announced problem statements.

  • Participants must submit their solutions within the specified deadline of the 36-hour hackathon.

  • Teams must follow the instructions and submission guidelines provided by the organizers.

  • Participants must maintain fair play and professional conduct throughout the competition.

  • Any form of malpractice or violation of competition rules may lead to disqualification.

  • The decisions of the judges and organizing committee will be final.

Additional Information

Free Consultation Eligibility: To be eligible for the free 30-minute consultation with industry professionals or researchers, participants must present their solution during the hackathon evaluation. Only participants who present their solutions will be considered for the selection of the 10 lucky participants.

InterviewBuddy Rewards: Interview vouchers and discount coupons will be distributed through official event communication channels. Redemption instructions, validity periods, and applicable terms will be communicated to eligible participants.

Navan AI Community Access: All registered participants are eligible for complimentary access to Navan AI's paid Skool community, with no restriction on the number of eligible participants. Invitations or joining instructions will be provided through official event communications. Access details for open-source AI workflows and development frameworks will also be shared with participants.

Navan AI Mentorship: Participation of a Navan AI team member as a mentor or judge is subject to availability and coordination between the organizers and Navan AI.

The tracks are out, the stage is set, and the countdown is on!

Bring your team together, explore the announced AI & ML tracks on our official social media platforms, put your skills to the test, and get ready for 36 hours of innovation, collaboration, and competition at Data Sprint 2.0!

ENLIST • COMPETE • ACHIEVE
